messages:
alex: Heads-up: planning to roll out the feature flag `prefetch-cache-v3` to prod tomorrow 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC. This is a non-urgent capacity optimizer. Need deploy owner, smoke-runner, and rollback ready.

maria: I can own the deploy. I'll do the preflight at 21:30 UTC and trigger the canary cadence.

jit: I'll run the smoke tests and monitor SLOs for the first 30m after each step. Will also run the eval prompt set.

alex: Thanks. Proposed cadence: 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100%, 12m wait between stages. If any latency spike > +50ms p50 or error rate > 0.5% roll back immediately. Keep default=false so new tenants stay off.

sam: @maria please keep the canary on a small tenant cohort (internal + beta customers). I can prepare the log/metric dashboards and a quick KQL for traces.

maria: noted. Deploy plan (short):
- 21:30 preflight (smoke infra, config sync, migrations none)
- 22:00 start canary (5%)
- 22:12 promote (25%) if green
- 22:24 promote (75%)
- 22:36 finalize (100%)

I'll post status updates in this thread at each step.

jit: Smoke checklist I'll run for each stage:
- health check endpoints (200)
- tail errors for model servers
- p50/p95 latency dashboards
- sample outputs for QA prompt set (sanity checks)
- redis/mem cache hit ratio

If any check fails I will say "rollback" and give quick reason.

olivia: On-call aware? Notifying SRE (oncall) and agreement on rollback command?

sre-bot: Notified: SRE oncall paged -> oncall@redwood.dev (silenced for test window if needed).

alex: Rollback commands (two options):
```bash
# feature flag CLI (preferred)
ri flags set prefetched-cache-v3 --env prod --value false --actor maria
# REST (if CLI unavailable)
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood.local/v1/flags/prefetched-cache-v3 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"value":false, "note":"rollback due to smoke"}'
```

sam: I'll have dashboards ready under Observability > Deployments > prefetch-cache-v3. Quick queries: 
- errors: `rate(request_errors[5m]) by (service)`
- latency: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[2m])) by (le, service))`

maria: small ops note: we'll use staged rollout gate `gate.deploy_window=night` and keep `safemode=true` for first 24h. That sets automatic conservative defaults for batching/caching heuristics.

jit: Good. Also will run the QA prompt set and attach 10 representative outputs per stage. If quality regressions > 3% we abort.

olivia: Who's the fallback owner if @maria is offline during the window?
maria: @olivia you can trigger rollback if I don't ack within 5 minutes of a problem. I'll add you as actor on the flag.

sre-bot: CI passed: build/serve-runtime #8421 succeeded. Canary images pushed to registry `registry.redwood/prod/prefetch-cache-v3:canary`

alex: Final checklist before 22:00: 
- @maria: preflight done?
- @jit: smoke dashboards ready?
- @sam: queries pinned?
- @olivia: fallback actor added?

maria: preflight green at 21:37 UTC. All infra checks ok.
jit: dashboards live, QA set uploading.
sam: queries pinned and alerted.
olivia: fallback actor added, confirms I can act.

alex: Great — starting at 22:00 UTC. I'll be available until 23:30 for post-rollout wrap. Post-rollout: add a short note to release-notes channel and mark the flag for audit (owner=maria, change=staged rollout).

maria: Will update thread at each stage. :)

[thread end]
